$comment: Size budgets of the surface bundle in bytes (spec 019), checked by `npm run surface:budget` in CI's build job. Set with 10–17 % headroom over the minified build of 2026-11-23 (entry 76.8 kB gzip, largest chunk 25.8 kB, total 145.2 kB gzip / 452 kB raw, 10 files). Raised 2026-11-24 for posts, replies, profiles and activity (specs 023–027): their pages load as separate chunks, so the entry is unchanged and only the totals grew (total 169 kB gzip / 522 kB raw, 26 files); new limits keep about 12 % headroom. Raise a limit only with a reviewer's agreement and the reason in the PR. Spec 040 (2026-11-24): the LiveKit call chunk (assets/call.*.js, loaded only when a viewer joins a call) has its own limit, callChunkGzip = the measured 137.3 kB gzip plus about 15 % headroom, and is left out of the other totals; entryGzipBeforeCalls is the entry measured on spec 033's branch before calls (77,055 bytes), and the entry may grow at most 4 kB over it. Raised 2026-11-25 for recordings, replay, broadcast and the rooms page (specs 041–047): each loads as its own chunk, the entry is 78.1 kB, and only the totals grew (219.2 kB gzip / 679.7 kB raw, 50 files); new limits keep about 12 % headroom.
